context_requirements: Expression of DAGLA and/or DAGLB in the cell line
Presence of the relevant lipid substrate pool (diacylglycerol) for the enzyme
A transcriptional readout linked to DAGLA/DAGLB activity, which is not established in these lines
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h that are shared across most or all nine cell lines
A clear transcriptional signature that correlates with DAGLA/DAGLB expression levels across the nine lines
Changes in lipid-metabolism landmark genes (e.g., FASN, SCD, HMGCR, INSIG1) that are specific to this class and not seen with vehicle
